newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 1.30 pct up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 1.30 pct up on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 1.30 percent up on Wednesday on heavy short-covering in a few blue chips and institutional support and the index was likely to remain firm in near term in an oversold market, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 17.66 points to end at 1,379.17. Gainers led losers 126 to 114.

The rise was on technicals as people were in an oversold position and disregarded three bomb blasts in Karachi, a dealer said. "Foreign buying in Hub Power at lower levels sparked panic short-covering by speculators in the scrip that also reflected in a few other blue chips." Hub Power rose 1.25 rupees to 32.
